comment: Fixtures that MUST produce at least one lint error: files Godot refuses to load, so the linter must error on them. This list names a fixture in a sub-folder that holds a project.godot by its basename, and fixtureLint.test.ts lints it with that project's files. linter/fixtureLint.test.ts reads this list and asserts that they DO error. scripts/githooks/negativeFixtures.mjs reads it for the pre-commit and pre-push hooks, which skip them, so a commit or a push does not fail on them. A linter red test does not belong here: assert the validator or rule directly. Adding or retiring an entry also moves NEGATIVE_FIXTURE_COUNT in that test, which is what keeps a retirement deliberate.
